outputs.name: hero-extra-motion
outputs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production full-body game animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the ACTUAL EDIT TARGET: hero-extra-motion-guide.png. Input image 2 is STYLE / CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY: hero-actions-v4.png.
DIRECTLY PAINT OVER IMAGE 1. Output exactly 1536x1536 pixels with its existing 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 complete connected full-body cels. Preserve the target's entire composition and each pose, facing, center, baseline, character height and scale, shoulder/hip angles, hand and foot coordinates, bent joints, silhouette and limb overlap. Do not copy poses from image 2.
Replace only the low-resolution pixel rendering by rich realistic sword-and-sorcery oil-painted anatomy and the SAME hero identity seen in image 2: muscular tan long-haired dark-haired barbarian, bronze bracers, fur/leather loincloth and belt, brown fur-trimmed boots, ornate double-headed bronze axe where target holds a weapon. Keep body proportions and costume consistent across all 12 cels. Preserve the weapon's hand positions and handle orientation when replacing target sword by axe. Do not add weapons to unarmed running or tackle cels.
Row 1 (top): preserve all four EXACT different running keys from target.
Row 2 (middle): preserve running shoulder-charge transition then three compact diagonal shoulder-tackle poses EXACTLY as target; tucked arms and leaning torso, feet at target positions.
Row 3 (bottom): preserve the four exact jumping-attack keys, including raised knee and overhead windup, raised weapon, then low downward strike and same strike hold. Erase white motion arc marks; paint only the physical weapon in its original orientation.
Background must be perfectly solid bright chroma-key green RGB(0,255,0). Keep all existing generous green padding and cell locations. No ground, shadows, labels, grids, motion streaks, effects, extra figures, extra legs, floating limbs or separate limb pieces. Every cel is one complete full-body character. CRITICAL: This is a registered texture/style paintover of the existing sprites, not a redesign of poses or a new composition.
